# Findings of TruffleHog that are not credentials: test vectors and examples.
# One line for each: DETECTOR FILE:LINE COMMIT (12 hex digits or more) # reason.

# pod-proxy (T-013): the proxy URLs of podssh's tests and the placeholder of
# its 407 words, with a made-up user and password, at proxy.example (a
# reserved name) or at a documentation address.
URI crates/pod-proxy/tests/dial.rs:28 614f68ae9319  # user:p%40ss at proxy.example, the decoding of a proxy's user
URI crates/pod-proxy/tests/dial.rs:41 614f68ae9319  # us%40er at a documentation address, a proxy's URL at its address
URI crates/pod-proxy/src/proxy_auth.rs:68 614f68ae9319  # USER:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT, a placeholder in the advice for a 407
URI crates/pod-proxy/src/proxy_auth.rs:69 e2be69f86329  # the same placeholder, with the program of the settings

# pod-proxy (T-014): the proxy URLs of podnet's tests, with a made-up user
# and password, at a private address, at a name of a test or at the
# loopback; first in the import of podnet, then in the tests of the crate.
URI crates/pod-proxy/src/podnet_import/egress.rs:1535 4b22d84e8131  # user:p%40ss at 10.0.0.1, the decoding of a proxy's password
URI crates/pod-proxy/src/podnet_import/egress.rs:1543 4b22d84e8131  # u:secret at h, a made-up password that the label hides
URI crates/pod-proxy/src/podnet_import/egress.rs:1705 4b22d84e8131  # user:pa%2Fss at proxy, the same slash encoded
URI crates/pod-proxy/src/podnet_import/tests/egress.rs:437 4b22d84e8131  # user:secretpw at 127.0.0.1:9, a password that no message shows
URI crates/pod-proxy/src/proxy/tests.rs:28 983961913b36  # user:p%40ss at 10.0.0.1, the decoding of a proxy's password
URI crates/pod-proxy/src/proxy/tests.rs:36 983961913b36  # u:secret at h, a made-up password that the label hides
URI crates/pod-proxy/src/proxy/tests.rs:1 983961913b36  # user:pa/ss at proxy (the scanner gives line 1 for line 98), a slash in a password that is not encoded
URI crates/pod-proxy/src/proxy/tests.rs:100 983961913b36  # user:pa%2Fss at proxy, the same slash encoded
